How it drives

A fast car with excellent drift but lighter steering control. DRIFTAGE holds speed and angle through linked corners.

Original perk

DRIFT drains less speed, steering becomes more aggressive and the car can hold larger slip angles.

epic Can also be installed on other cars through PERKULATOR.

Try a build

CARRY ON complements a LOCK-heavy approach. Practise banking the slide before pushing the angle further.

Practice: Harbor. Explore CARRY ON.

Example SHIFT setup

One legal example moves one point per attribute. Lower TOP SPEED, ACCELERATION, DRIFT; raise CONTROL, BOOST POWER, BOOST TANK. Try the two states on the same section to feel the trade-off.

Set up SHIFT in GARAGE after 1,000 trophies · Shift.
